notes: Medium (total 11). The task consolidates five unrelated parsing/transformation slices into one /app/solve.py + answer.json contract. Difficulty is spread across hidden_case_generalization (2): the verifier runs the produced program against three distinct unseen datasets, so hardcoding the visible rows/files fails every hidden case. adversarial_inputs (2): edge inputs include >5 categories with a rank-5/rank-6 tie, unparseable amounts ('N/A', empty), invalid IPv4 (octet>255, leading zeros, IPv6), multiple dates per line (rightmost wins), ICS events missing DTEND (skipped), and exact-boundary overlap probes (half-open). quantitative_correctness (2): category ranking must sum absolute amounts and select exactly the top five in strict order. reasoning_depth (2) for binding the IP validity + last-date rule and the half-open interval semantics; debugging_ambiguity (1) and tool_breadth (2) for mixing csv/ics/regex/json in one pipeline. No resource pressure or statefulness: single self-contained script over small fixtures.
